author: Unreal Engine
description:
Watch this video and discover how UE5 put wind in the sails of ‘Oceanhorn 3’, empowering the small indie team at Cornfox & Brothers to deliver a swashbuckling cinematic RPG across iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple TV.

The latest installment of the hit action-adventure Oceanhorn franchise has taken to the waves: Oceanhorn 3: Legend of the Shadow Sea.
For this newest chapter, Finnish indie studio Cornfox & Brothers had ambitious plans including a new battle system, deeper RPG mechanics, a rich narrative, and bigger, better boss fights.

Check out the interview to find out how Unreal Engine’s out-of-the-box features such as Blueprint visual scripting, Mobile Previewer, and Sequencer empowered every member of the team to pull their weight.

Read the full interview here: https://epic.gm/dev-interviews-oceanhorn-3
